setup.intro: Day 12 of the outbreak. Your group has barricaded itself inside a suburban shopping mall. The food court is running low, and nobody trusts the escalators.

roles.title: The Self-Appointed Leader
roles.blurb: Wrote a whiteboard of rules on day one. Nobody voted for this.

roles.title: The Medic (Watched Grey's Anatomy Once)
roles.blurb: Very confident. Holds the only first-aid kit.

roles.title: The Scavenger
roles.blurb: Knows where everything is in the mall and isn't telling.

roles.title: The Morale Officer
roles.blurb: Keeps spirits up with snacks and increasingly unhinged pep talks.

roles.title: The Suspiciously Calm One
roles.blurb: Hasn't panicked once. That's the problem.

relationships: {a} saved {b} from a zombie on day 3 and brings it up constantly.
{a} thinks {b} was bitten and is hiding it.
{a} and {b} share a night watch shift and have a secret handshake.
{a} owes {b} a favour, and {b} has not forgotten.
{a} is convinced {b} would leave the group behind first.

secret.title: Running on empty
secret.scene: Night falls on day 12. The food court shutters rattle, and everyone goes quiet over dinner. Each of you knows something the others don't.

briefs.secret: You counted the stockroom. There is food for three more days, not the two weeks everyone thinks.
briefs.prompt: What do you do with this?

options.outcome: {name} announced the food count. Dinner portions were halved on the spot.
{name} secretly shrank everyone's portions. People are hungry and don't know why.
{name} now has a hidden stash of crackers behind the vending machine.

briefs.secret: You found a map to a warehouse full of supplies. The only route goes through the zombie-filled parking garage.

options.outcome: {name} came back at dawn with a trolley of tinned beans and a torn jacket.
{name} dragged {someone} through the garage. They got supplies and a new mutual grudge.
{name} burned the map. Nobody will ever know it existed.

briefs.secret: There is exactly one dose of antibiotics left, and two people have a fever.
briefs.outcome: {name} gave the last dose to {choice}. The other patient is still coughing.

briefs.secret: The back door barricade is failing. You can fix it tonight, but it means using the wood from everyone's beds.

options.outcome: {name} dismantled every bed. The door holds. Everyone slept on the floor.
{name} built a mannequin wall. It is terrifying and only mostly works.
{name} left the door. Something was scratching at it all night.

briefs.secret: A rival group radioed you privately. They'll trade medicine for the location of your mall.

options.outcome: {name} made a deal. Medicine is coming, and so are strangers who know where you live.
{name} sent the rival group to an empty car wash. They will not be happy.
{name} is now on friendly terms with the rival group's radio operator.

briefs.secret: You were scratched by something in the stockroom this afternoon. Probably a shelf. Probably.

options.outcome: {name} admitted the scratch. Everyone keeps glancing at them.

options.text: Hide it under a long sleeve
options.outcome: {name} is wearing a long sleeve in 30 degree heat. Nobody has asked. Yet.
{name} told everyone {someone} scratched them. {someone} is very confused.

secret.title: Strangers at the gate
secret.scene: Morning. A group of strangers is waiting at the mall entrance, waving a white shirt. Everyone is summoned to the atrium, but first you each have a moment alone.

briefs.secret: You recognise one of the strangers. They robbed a pharmacy with you before the outbreak.

options.outcome: {name} vouched for the strangers. The group let them in, trusting {name}.
{name} pretended not to know them. The stranger winked at {name} anyway.
{name} exposed the stranger's past, and a bit of their own by accident.

briefs.secret: The strangers' truck outside has a full fuel tank. With it, the group could reach the army base.

options.outcome: {name} traded half the canned food for the truck keys.
{name} pocketed the truck keys while everyone slept.
{name} kept the truck a secret. The strangers still have it.

briefs.secret: Only you have the key to the gate. Whatever happens, it's your hand that opens it or doesn't.

options.outcome: {name} opened the gate. The mall just got a lot more crowded.
{name} kept the gate shut. The strangers left, shouting insults.
{name} traded through the bars. Nobody got in, but everyone got socks.

briefs.secret: One of the strangers is a child, and they look sick.
briefs.prompt: Who do you ask to help you care for the child?
briefs.outcome: {name} brought the sick child inside and put {choice} in charge of looking after them.

briefs.secret: You could sneak out the back while everyone is distracted and scout the strangers' camp.

options.outcome: {name} found the strangers' camp and a whole crate of chocolate.
{name} stayed behind and kept an eye on everyone. Very closely.

briefs.secret: Your scratch from last night is itching. Your hands are shaking a bit.

options.text: Lock yourself in the photo booth
options.outcome: {name} spent the morning in the photo booth. There are 400 very dramatic photos.
{name} acted normal. Suspiciously normal.

options.text: Ask {someone} to keep an eye on you
options.outcome: {name} confided in {someone}, who now has to watch them sleep.

secret.title: The last night
secret.scene: The horde is coming. There's a van with space for everyone, but the route out is blocked, and each of you controls a piece of the escape.

briefs.secret: The van only starts if someone stays behind to hold the loading bay door for thirty seconds.
briefs.outcome: {name} decided {choice} would hold the door. They made it into the van with one second to spare.

briefs.secret: You know a second exit through the sewer. It's safe, but it only fits a few people and it smells unbelievable.

options.outcome: {name} revealed the sewer. Half the group took it and have not stopped complaining.

options.text: Keep it as your own backup
options.outcome: {name} kept the sewer to themselves, just in case.

briefs.secret: The van only has room for one bag of supplies.
briefs.outcome: {name} chose {choice}'s bag. Everyone else lost their stuff, including a very beloved pillow.

briefs.secret: You could lure the horde away by running through the food court with the karaoke machine blasting.

options.outcome: {name} ran through the mall blasting a power ballad. The horde followed. Legendary.
{name} got in the van and sensibly buckled up.

briefs.secret: The rival group is on the radio again, offering to cover your escape if you owe them one favour, unspecified.

options.outcome: {name} accepted. The group now owes a mysterious favour to strangers.
{name} said no thanks. The rival group sounded hurt.
{name} volunteered {someone} for the favour without asking.

briefs.secret: Your hand has stopped shaking. You feel fine. Actually, you feel great.

options.outcome: {name} got in the van, grinning. Nobody has sat next to them since.
{name} waved the van goodbye from the roof. A hero, or a future zombie.

choice.scene: A voice on the radio promises safety at an army base 40 km away. The catch: you'd have to leave the mall tonight.
options: Stay. The mall has a Cinnabon.
Answer the radio with a fake name

choice.scene: A stranger knocks on the barricade holding a full bag of groceries. They say they're 'definitely not bitten.'
options: Take the groceries, not the stranger

choice.scene: The power flickers. Someone has to go down to the basement generator. Alone. In the dark.
options: Give a long speech until someone else volunteers

vote_player.scene: The last can of peaches sits on the food court table. Everyone saw it. Nobody has touched it... yet.
vote_player.prompt: Who would secretly eat the last can of peaches tonight?

vote_player.scene: A horde is heading for the mall. The escape van has room for everyone, but somebody is going to slow things down.
vote_player.prompt: Who is most likely to get the group caught because of something ridiculous?

vote_player.scene: Rescue finally arrives. The soldier asks who was in charge of your group.
vote_player.prompt: Who would claim to be the leader, whether or not it's true?

predict.scene: {target} finds a working shower in the gym. First hot water in 12 days. The horde is 10 minutes away.
options: Tells everyone and makes a rota
Guards the door with a mop

predict.scene: A rival survivor group with much better food offers {target} a spot. Only {target}.
{target} can take one luxury item on the escape van.

titles: Most Likely to Befriend a Zombie
Would Survive Out of Pure Spite
recap.epilogue: You made it out of the mall. The group chat will never be the same.
